acceptanceCriteria: Linux 1k and 100k runs show descriptor peaks flat in receipt count, retained as evidence.
body:
Source: V1-0906 lane report (2026-10-11), codex/v1-0906-bounded-fds a0796d233.

Observed: the descriptor-bound qualification (median peak 821 watched / 534 fallback at 100k receipts) ran on Darwin/kqueue only; the Linux inotify change-guard path is NOT_RUN. Also, the focused store pattern `CALV0|Descriptor|ChangeGuard` with -race exceeded 30 min on a loaded shared host.

Expected: a Linux run of CORVINT_V10906_LARGE=1 TestCALV0221 and the guard tests, with retained peaks; and a narrower documented focused pattern.
